summary: Five attacks, four clean and one low-severity finding. All 33 directed links resolve to stages that exist, with no self-link and so no cycle through AdicSpaces. All 90 evidence quotes are genuine — none is fabricated or paraphrased — but 18 of the 90 attribute their quote to a stageId when the quoted sentence lives in the target roadmap's roadmap-level prose (its JSON summary, or its content/campaign README) rather than in that stage, which is the finding. All 8 overlaps resolve on both sides with valid recommendations. The 218-entry examined record is internally consistent with the links and overlaps it reports: every one of the 12 distinct link-target roadmaps and all 8 overlap partners appear with a result of 'links' or 'overlap', and the one extra roadmap marked 'links' is AdicSpaces itself, correctly recorded as focal. Spot-checking the adic-foundational neighbourhood for omissions found none: the three roadmaps that looked like plausible missing links are each justified in the examined notes.
checked: All 33 links, both endpoints, against every stage id in the atlas. Sources: all 33 are AdicSpaces layer ids and all resolve (layer 5 supplies 8, layer 2 seven, layer 4 six, layers 0 and 3 four each, layers 1 and 6 two each). Targets: all 33 resolve. Confidence split 27 explicit / 6 inferred, matching the summary.
Cycles: no link has a target inside tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/AdicSpaces, so the map is acyclic through the focal roadmap by construction.

Two false alarms of my own, resolved and recorded so the next red team does not repeat them. (a) SolidAnalyticRings:SA.3 and :SA.4 first appeared absent: there are two roadmap directories, research/blueprint/atlas/roadmaps/ and research/blueprint/roadmaps/, and SolidAnalyticRings lives in the second. (b) Even then the ids did not match, because that file stores stage ids bare ('SA.3') while atlas roadmaps store them fully qualified; indexing both forms resolves them. The targets are apt: SA.3 is 'Solid finite-type algebras, discrete Huber pairs and dis...', SA.4 is 'Solid Huber rings, bounded and Gelfand rings, and normed...'.

Every evidence quote, 90 in all, against the text of the stage its stageId names, then against the whole target roadmap, then against that roadmap's README. 72 are verbatim in the cited stage; 16 are verbatim in the target roadmap's JSON summary or prerequisites but not in the cited stage; 2 are in the roadmap's content/campaign README and not in the JSON at all. None is missing, so no quote is fabricated.

All 8 overlaps: both stage ids of each pair resolve, and the recommendations are 'rescope' (7) and 'keep' (1). The pairs are AdicSpaces layer 5 against AdicSpacesPartII:R0, AdicEtaleGeometry:A2 and PerfectoidSpaces:P4; layer 6 against FarguesFontaineDiamonds:F2, RelativeFarguesFontaine:RF1 and AInfCohomology:AI.0; layer 1 against DiamondsAndVStacks:D0; layer 3 against SolidAnalyticRings:SA.3.

The examined record against the links and overlaps it reports. 218 entries with results overlap (1), links (13), none (204). All 12 distinct link-target roadmaps are marked 'links' or 'overlap'; all 8 overlap partners appear, 7 as 'links' and AInfCohomology as 'overlap' (it carries an overlap but no link, which is what the value distinguishes). The 13th 'links' entry is tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/AdicSpaces itself, noted as the focal roadmap with 'Layer inputs are Mathlib only, so no inward link was found'.

Omissions, by screening every roadmap in both directories whose title or summary mentions adic-foundational vocabulary (valuation, spectral space, topological ring, Huber, Tate algebra, affinoid, Berkovich, rigid analytic, formal scheme): 20 roadmaps. The three that looked like plausible missing links are each justified in the examined notes. ClassicalAdicEtaleCohomology is 'none' because 'AdicSpaces does not supply these etale cohomology theorems' and 'Adic carriers arrive through AdicEtaleGeometry A1/A2', which is itself a link target. TropicalAndBerkovichArithmetic is 'links', with the specific link L2 -> TB.0 recorded. tauceti:TauCetiRoadmap/LocalFieldsRamification is 'none' because 'The discretely valued local-field theory neither supplies nor uses Huber rings, Spa or rank-one perfect fields'.

findings.where: research/blueprint/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_AdicSpaces.json, the evidence entries of 12 links: targets AdicSpacesPartII:F0, :R0, :R2, :R3; PerfectoidSpaces:P1, :P2; AdicEtaleGeometry:A0, :A4; RelativeFarguesFontaine:RF0:integral-Y, :RF0:annuli, :RF1; ColemanIntegration:L1
findings.claim: 18 of the 90 evidence entries attribute their quote to a stageId when the quoted sentence is not in that stage's text. In every case the quote is genuine and is verbatim in the target roadmap's roadmap-level prose — its JSON 'summary' or 'prerequisites' field, or its content/campaign/<id>/README.md — and the same sentence is cited against several different stages of that one roadmap. The links themselves are sound and the quotes do justify them; what is wrong is the provenance pointer, so a verifier who follows stageId to check a quote will not find it there.
findings.evidence: Counting all 90 evidence entries: 72 are verbatim in the cited stage, 16 are verbatim in the target roadmap but not in the cited stage, and 2 are in the roadmap README and not in the roadmap JSON at all; 0 are missing. Instances. 'This is a successor to AdicSpaces, not another construction of valuation spectra...' is the summary field of atlas/roadmaps/AdicSpacesPartII.json and is cited against stages F0, R2 and R3. 'Its starting point is AdicSpaces, not a pre-existing tilting or almost...' is the summary field of atlas/roadmaps/PerfectoidSpaces.json and is cited against P1 and P2. 'This component starts at the actual endpoint of AdicSpaces Layers 0-5.' is the summary field of atlas/roadmaps/AdicEtaleGeometry.json and is cited against A0 and A4. 'Dependencies: upstream AdicSpaces and LocalFieldsRamification; ...' is cited against RF0:integral-Y, RF0:annuli and RF1. 'AdicSpaces for rigid/adic analytic domains and gluing' is cited against ColemanIntegration:L1. The two README cases are 'The principal categories are analytic locally strongly noetherian adic...' cited against AdicSpacesPartII:R0, found in content/campaign/AdicSpacesPartII/README.md, and 'Cohomology statements refer to the same structure sheaves as AdicSpaces...' cited against PerfectoidSpaces:P2, found in content/campaign/PerfectoidSpaces/README.md.
findings.fix: Re-point these 18 evidence entries at the level the quote actually comes from, leaving the 33 link verdicts unchanged. Either give the entry a roadmap-level key instead of a stage-level one (for example {roadmapId, quote} beside the existing {stageId, quote}, with a source field naming 'summary', 'prerequisites' or 'readme'), or keep stageId and add the roadmap-level quote as a separate entry so that each quote is checkable where it is stored. If the links-v1 schema is not to change, the minimum fix is to replace each of the 18 quotes with a sentence from the cited stage's own description that carries the same force.
